## MGIT Successfully Hosts Internal Hackathon for Smart India Hackathon 2023

News Date : 28 Sep 2023News ReportMGIT showcased the brilliance of its students in the recently concluded internal hackathon for Smart India Hackathon 2023. Held on 26th and 27th September, the event witnessed participation from 75 teams, amounting to over 450 innovative minds converging for two days of intensive coding and solution development.The esteemed jury panel for the event comprised Mr. Rakeesh Punna, Project Manager at Solix; Mr. Srishuk Kumar Bhagwat, Principal Software Engineer at eSolutionsFirst Services Pvt Ltd; and Dr. A. Rajanikanth, Professor and Head – Department of Information Technology, CBIT. Their combined expertise played a pivotal role in evaluating the groundbreaking solutions presented. The jury unanimously commended the students for their excellence and the innovative ideas showcased during the hackathon.This hackathon not only acted as a platform for budding innovators but also solidified MGIT’s commitment to fostering a culture of technological advancement and innovation. The successful conclusion of this event sets the stage for MGIT representatives at the national Smart India Hackathon 2023.
